Website types

Website design for the way your business works.

Your website is often where a potential client decides whether the business feels relevant, trustworthy, and easy to contact. A sector-aware structure helps people recognize the fit quickly and move toward booking, visiting, or requesting a quote.

Health clinic and studio websites

Give patients a calm, credible path from understanding the services to making contact or booking.

  • Explain services and practitioner fit clearly.
  • Support calls, forms, and booking without friction.

FAQ

Questions before the project starts.

What does “From $850” mean?+

It is the approved starting reference for a focused website project. The exact quote is confirmed after reviewing the pages, content, integrations, and support requirements.

How accurate are the timelines above?+

They are working estimates after scope approval, assuming content, access, and feedback arrive on schedule. Complex migrations, integrations, copywriting, or delayed approvals can extend the project.

Will the website work on phones and tablets?+

Responsive design and front-end development are part of the core service contract. The agreed routes and conversion paths are tested at relevant breakpoints before handoff.

Can you connect forms or online booking?+

Yes, when included in the agreed scope. We confirm the endpoint, validation, notification, privacy, and staging behavior before launch.

Is SEO included?+

Clear page structure and technical foundations can be included in the website scope. Broader SEO research, content, and implementation are scoped separately when needed.

What happens before launch?+

We verify the agreed content, links, forms, responsive behavior, performance, analytics, and release details, then provide a documented handoff.
